statement.text:
Let X, Y be Fitting classes of soluble groups which satisfy the Lockett condition,
i. e. X ∩ S∗ = X∗ , Y ∩ S∗ = Y∗ where S denotes the Fitting class of all soluble
groups and the lower star the bottom group of the Lockett section determined by the
given Fitting class. Does X ∩ Y satisfy the Lockett condition?
    Editors’ comment (2001): The answer is affirmative if X and Y are local (A. Gry-
tczuk, N. T. Vorob’ev, Tsukuba J. Math., 18, no. 1 (1994), 63–67).            H. Lausch
